THINKING: We need to determine which category taxes on customs fall under.

A. Trading refers to transactions, not directly related to taxes on customs.
B. Production on goods seems unrelated to taxes on customs.
C. Income is related to individuals, not directly related to taxes on customs.
D. Consumption or spending is more relevant, as customs taxes affect goods imported or consumed.

ANSWER: الضرائب الجمركية هي مثال للضرائب على الاستهلاك، أو الإنفاق.
FINAL: الضرائب الجمركية هي مثال للضرائب على الاستهلاك، أو الإنفاق.
